statements.proposition: This change adds a test that passes custom metadata when generating a bundle.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: The statement says a test was added, not that it passes; I did not run it. Reading the code, the new test passes metadata_fields containing meta_agent_version while generate() also passes meta_agent_version=__version__ to BundleMetadata, which would raise a duplicate-keyword TypeError, so the test may fail. That is outside the proposition.
